clauses.title: Liaison officer
clauses.description: Designate a liaison officer with NCA for cybersecurity risk management activation

clauses.title: Asset inventory
clauses.description: Inventory and classify all organization assets (sensitive systems, OT, social media accounts, etc.) per NCA guidance, and review classification periodically

clauses.title: Internet-facing assets
clauses.description: Inventory internet-facing assets

clauses.title: Report to NCA via Haseen
clauses.description: Report identified assets (from 5.2 and 5.3) to NCA periodically via Haseen platform, and update upon any change

clauses.title: Report high/catastrophic risks
clauses.description: Report cybersecurity risks at catastrophic (level 5) and high (level 4) levels to NCA immediately upon identification, per the risk assessment matrix (Figure 2), and share treatment plans periodically

clauses.title: Address NCA feedback
clauses.description: Address risks, vulnerabilities, and observations received from NCA; report on remediation actions periodically via Haseen platform

clauses.title: Continuous program
clauses.description: Develop and operate a continuous program for cybersecurity risk management methodology with dedicated resources

clauses.title: Stakeholder engagement
clauses.description: Engage stakeholders in various phases (e.g., cybersecurity supervisory committee, IT department)

clauses.title: Asset inventory
clauses.description: Inventory and classify organization assets

clauses.title: Vulnerability inventory
clauses.description: Inventory cybersecurity vulnerabilities

clauses.title: Threat inventory
clauses.description: Inventory potential cybersecurity threats

clauses.title: Risk scenarios
clauses.description: Develop expected cybersecurity risk scenarios based on threats and vulnerabilities

clauses.title: Current controls
clauses.description: Identify currently applied controls to address expected risk scenarios

clauses.title: Acceptable risk level
clauses.description: Determine acceptable risk level for the organization

clauses.title: Inherent risk analysis
clauses.description: Conduct inherent risk analysis for all expected risk scenarios and currently applied controls, assessing likelihood and impact per the risk assessment matrix (Figure 2)

clauses.title: Risk register
clauses.description: Document analysis and assessment results in the cybersecurity risk register

clauses.title: Treatment plans
clauses.description: Develop cybersecurity risk treatment plans

clauses.title: Residual risk
clauses.description: Assess expected residual risk after executing treatment plans to confirm acceptable risk level is reached

clauses.title: Treatment decision
clauses.description: Make risk treatment decision (accepting, sharing, mitigating, or avoiding) and define related treatment plans

clauses.title: Prioritize treatment plans
clauses.description: Prioritize treatment plans

clauses.title: Execute treatment plans
clauses.description: Execute treatment plans

clauses.title: Update risk register
clauses.description: Update cybersecurity risk register to include treatment plans and residual risks

clauses.title: Reports
clauses.description: Develop cybersecurity risk management reports

clauses.title: Statistical criteria
clauses.description: Establish statistical data collection criteria for risk monitoring

clauses.title: Periodic follow-up
clauses.description: Monitor treatment plan execution periodically and issue related reports

clauses.title: Re-execute on change
clauses.description: Re-execute risk management methodology periodically, or per NCA guidance, or upon change in: treatment plans, potential threats, expected scenarios, control implementation status, or digital infrastructure
